summary: Saves the values of all non-nosave global variables in the current object to file `name`. The master object valid_write() method controls whether the write is allowed. The optional second argument is a bit field (00, 01, 10, 11). If bit 0 is set (01 or 11), variables whose value is 0 are also saved; normally they are not. Object-typed variables are always saved as 0. If bit 1 is set (10 or 11), the save file is compressed.
details:
Return semantics:
Returns 1 if saving succeeds, or 0 on failure.
